instruction.text: Match the facts to the years written as Roman numerals.

atoms.a: The Battle of Hastings was fought in 1066.
Queen Elizabeth II’s coronation was in 1953.
The first colony in America was founded in 1607.

instruction.text: Match the facts to the years written as Roman numerals.

atoms.a: The Wars of the Roses began in 1455.
Captain Cook first landed in Australia in 1770.
The COVID-19 disease was first seen in 2019.

instruction.text: Write the year in Roman numerals.

atoms.b: ((I V X L C D ++M)) ((I V X L C ++D M)) ((++I V X L C D M)) ((I V ++X L C D M))

atoms.a: The Second World War ended in 1945.
atoms.b: ((I V X L C D ++M)) ((I V X L ++C D M)) ((I V X L C D ++M)) ((I V ++X L C D M)) ((I V X ++L C D M)) ((I ++V X L C D M))

end.text: Great! Although the numeral MCMVL looks like it should also be 1945, this is actually not possible. Only the numerals I, X and C can be used to subtract in Roman numerals.
